_readme: Tyms MI — official MCP Registry server.json drafts (2026-11-02).
The registry publishes ONE server per server.json; it has no multi-server publish.
Extract any element of `drafts` into its own server.json and run:
Namespace ai.tyms/* requires DNS authentication: TXT record at the APEX of tyms.ai
(SPF-style placement; selector-style records fail). See playbook.md section 3.
Hostname resolved 2026-11-02: drafts point at production mi-api.tyms.ai (verified live).
Before publishing, confirm each /mcp/{domain}/{region} route answers on production
Descriptions are capped at 100 chars by the registry; all drafts comply (see _descriptionLengths).
websiteUrl carries venue=mcp-registry UTM attribution (see playbook.md section on attribution); replace the host with the marketing/docs site when available, keeping the utm params.
